title: Software Development Engineer II, Payroll Tech - Xylem
description:
**Description**
Are you looking for an opportunity to build a highly available, large scale, enterprise-wide software solution? Does it excite you to find patterns and build generic, composable software solutions to solve complex problems? Are you looking for inventing newer and simpler ways of building solutions? If so, we are looking for you to fill a challenging position in Amazon Payroll Technology team.
  
  
Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights.  As an SDE II on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products.
  
  
This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g., significant component, set of features, mid-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g., performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.) You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity). You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You re-use where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., designing to avoid impacting the system under test.)
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned engineer. In this position, you will play a leading role in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large-scale and complex financial applications. You will push your design and architecture limits by inventing and simplifying complex problems. You have strong verbal and written communication skills, are self-driven, and can deliver high quality results in a fast-paced environment. You will work with Amazon engineering and business teams across the globe in planning, designing, executing and implementing this new platform.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
**About The Role**
We’re looking for an experienced software engineer to help drive and evolve our data and AI security product. Our technology is new and rapidly evolving: you’ll be an early contributor with a substantial impact on the architecture and be solving multiple exciting technical challenges!
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* You'll design and implement highly scalable and fault-tolerant solutions to protect enterprise data across public clouds (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure), SaaS applications, and AI agents.
* You'll build security capabilities that provide visibility into and control over how AI agents discover, access, process, and share sensitive enterprise data.
* You'll solve real-world scaling problems that require thorough performance analysis and troubleshooting skills.
* You'll work with a modern and constantly evolving microservices-based software stack that includes Go, Kubernetes, Bigtable, BigQuery, Spanner, Redis, Docker, and more.
* You'll write robust, secure-by-design software that must withstand real-world attacks while processing untrusted data and communicating with hundreds of thousands of endpoints over the internet.
* Located in Bangalore (Bengaluru), India

**Who You Are**

* Proven Expertise: You have 5-8 yrs of industry experience in building high-scale security products. Experience in data security is highly preferred.
* AI Agents and Agentic Security: You have experience building AI agents, agentic applications, or security solutions for AI agents. Familiarity with agent frameworks, tool calling, MCP, and securing agent access to enterprise data is highly preferred.
* Cloud and SaaS Development: You have extensive experience developing distributed application software for public clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure) or SaaS applications.
* Data Integration at Scale: You are skilled in integrating and ingesting large-scale data from third-party SaaS, PaaS, or IaaS APIs.
* Programming Skills: You have extensive experience developing enterprise-scale applications, preferably in Go. Alternatively, you are proficient in Python, Java, or Rust.
* Database Proficiency: Familiarity with GCP Bigtable, BigQuery, or graph databases such as Neo4j or AWS Neptune is a plus.
* Performance Optimization: You have expertise in profiling and optimizing distributed code that interacts with large databases and streaming platforms.
* API and Microservices Development: You are experienced in designing and implementing RESTful APIs, with hands-on knowledge of microservices and Kubernetes.
* Communication Skills: You have excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and are comfortable collaborating frequently with distributed teams across Europe, India, and the US.

Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.
  
  
Backed by $250M from leading investors like Khosla and Redpoint, our team includes leaders who built industry-defining technologies at CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Meta, Google, and more. This role lets you shape the future of data security, working alongside people driven to protect workflows, not just data, for customers who cannot afford to slow down to stay safe.

title: Senior AI Software Engineer
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior AI Software Engineer based in India.**
As a Senior AI Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain advanced AI and machine learning solutions that address complex business challenges and deliver measurable value to clients. You will work at the intersection of AI engineering, data infrastructure, software development, and cloud technologies to build scalable, reliable, and production-ready applications. From generative AI and agentic AI to natural language processing and retrieval-augmented generation, you will help transform sophisticated AI capabilities into practical business solutions. Working closely with data scientists, software engineers, DevOps specialists, QA teams, and business stakeholders, you will ensure seamless integration and high-quality delivery. You will also analyze complex datasets, optimize machine learning pipelines, and identify emerging technologies that improve system performance and maintainability. This opportunity offers a collaborative, client-focused environment where technical innovation, continuous learning, and operational excellence are highly valued.
  
  
Accountabilities
  
  

* AI and machine learning solution development: Design, develop, implement, and maintain advanced AI/ML solutions that address client requirements and align with existing product capabilities and business objectives.
* Generative and agentic AI engineering: Build and integrate end-to-end solutions using generative AI, agentic AI, large language models (LLMs), natural language processing (NLP), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and related frameworks.
* Data analysis and preparation: Analyze client datasets, assess data complexity and consistency, collect information from multiple sources, and perform data cleaning, preprocessing, profiling, and transformation to ensure data quality and reliability.
* Machine learning model development: Apply appropriate machine learning and deep learning algorithms to identify patterns, generate insights, solve business problems, and improve the performance of AI-powered applications.
* Data engineering and pipeline management: Design, implement, and maintain data infrastructure, ETL processes, data integration workflows, and machine learning pipelines that support reliable model development and deployment.
* Software development and API integration: Develop production-ready software components, integrate APIs and external services, and support the implementation of AI solutions within existing applications and enterprise systems.
* AI application development: Build and maintain applications using technologies such as Python, FastAPI, LangChain, Hugging Face, PySpark, OCR tools, and relevant machine learning libraries.
* Cloud infrastructure and deployment: Support AI/ML workloads across cloud environments, including Microsoft Azure and AWS, while leveraging relevant infrastructure, containerization, monitoring, and data platform technologies.
* Performance monitoring and optimization: Develop dashboards and monitoring tools to track key performance indicators, evaluate system reliability, identify operational issues, and recommend improvements to existing machine learning systems.
* Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with business stakeholders, clients, data scientists, data engineers, software developers, QA engineers, and DevOps teams to maintain data accuracy and deliver integrated technical solutions.
* Technical research and innovation: Evaluate emerging AI, machine learning, and data engineering technologies, recommending tools, frameworks, and techniques that improve scalability, maintainability, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Insights and stakeholder communication: Conduct ad hoc analyses, communicate technical findings, and present clear, actionable recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Quality, accountability, and continuous improvement: Maintain high standards of integrity, client service, documentation, and delivery quality while taking ownership of outcomes and identifying opportunities to improve workflows and processes.

**Requirements**

* Education: A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline. Relevant qualifications such as B.Tech, MCA, or an MS in Computer Science are suitable.
* Professional experience: At least 5 years of relevant experience in AI/ML implementation, data engineering, software development, or related technical domains, with hands-on experience delivering and maintaining production-oriented solutions.
* Programming expertise: Strong proficiency in Python, with practical experience in software development, application integration, implementation, and API development.
* Generative and agentic AI: Hands-on end-to-end development experience with generative AI, agentic AI, LLMs, RAG, and NLP-based applications.
* AI frameworks and tools: Experience with FastAPI, LangChain, Hugging Face, RAGAS, PySpark, OCR technologies, and relevant NLP libraries and frameworks.
* Machine learning and deep learning: Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms and their implementation, with familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, Keras, and Pandas.
* Data engineering capabilities: Experience with ETL, data wrangling, data integration, data profiling, data quality management, metadata management, and data discovery. The ability to build and maintain reliable data pipelines is essential.
* Cloud and DevOps technologies: Practical experience with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS, with familiarity with Docker, Databricks, application monitoring tools such as Application Insights, and cloud-based deployment practices.
* LLM and API integration: Experience working with large language models, integrating APIs, and connecting AI components with enterprise systems and data sources.
* Data visualization and reporting: Familiarity with visualization and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or equivalent platforms to monitor performance and communicate insights.
* AI solution implementation: Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements and complex datasets into scalable, maintainable AI/ML applications that can be integrated into existing products and workflows.
* Analytical and problem-solving skills: Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to troubleshoot technical challenges, identify data inconsistencies, and optimize system performance.
* Communication and collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and work effectively with clients and multidisciplinary teams.
* Client-focused mindset: A commitment to understanding client needs, building productive relationships, maintaining confidentiality, and delivering solutions that meet agreed requirements.
* Ownership and decision-making: A results-oriented approach, with the ability to take initiative, make informed decisions, manage priorities, and remain effective in complex or changing situations.
* Innovation and adaptability: A willingness to explore emerging technologies, propose improvements, take calculated risks, and continuously develop technical skills.
* Operational excellence: A strong commitment to quality, documentation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement throughout the software and AI development lifecycle.

**Benefits**

* Flexible work arrangements: Opportunities for remote work in India, with hybrid working options available for certain office locations, including Hyderabad and Pune. The exact arrangement may depend on the assigned location and team.
* Competitive compensation: Salary determined by location-based market rates, relevant skills and experience, interview performance, and internal pay equity.
* Comprehensive benefits package: Additional employee benefits are available, with specific healthcare, insurance, leave, and other provisions to be confirmed during the recruitment process.
* Professional development: Access to learning opportunities designed to support technical growth, career progression, and ongoing skills development.
* Career mobility: Opportunities to explore different career paths and develop expertise across AI, machine learning, software engineering, and data technologies.
* Meaningful technical challenges: Work on complex AI and data solutions that support client needs and deliver value at scale.
* Collaborative environment: Partner with multidisciplinary teams in a workplace that emphasizes integrity, client focus, shared success, and continuous improvement.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to sit at the intersection of engineering, product, marketing, and the business. This is not a traditional engineering role. You will work directly with stakeholders to uncover complex business problems, architect practical AI-powered solutions, and ship production systems that deliver measurable impact.
  
  
The work is highly autonomous. You will not be handed detailed specifications. You are expected to interpret product requirements, ask the right questions of the right people, and determine what should be built. The ideal candidate is a strong technical builder and architect with excellent business and product judgment, who is genuinely comfortable working alongside non-technical teams, particularly consumer marketing.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and deploy AI-powered applications, agents, and automation systems using Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, Node.js, Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, and other LLM platforms.
* Work directly with marketing, product, and business teams to understand complex workflows, identify opportunities, and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Interpret product requirement documents and ambiguous business input independently, then define and drive the technical approach.
* Own architecture decisions across systems, data, and AI components, balancing speed of delivery with long-term maintainability.
* Build AI agents, RAG systems, tool-calling workflows, and LLM-powered applications using technologies such as LangChain, LangGraph, vector databases, embeddings, and MCP.
* Develop backend services, APIs, webhooks, integrations, and data pipelines connecting internal and third-party systems.
* Build and optimize data workflows using Snowflake, PostgreSQL, SQL, Supabase, Redis, dbt, and ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Integrate AI solutions with CRMs, marketing platforms, customer data platforms, analytics tools, and business applications.
* Build workflow automation using platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, and Power Automate.
* Develop internal tools, dashboards, and user-facing applications using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS when required.
* Deploy and maintain production systems using AWS or GCP, Docker, serverless infrastructure, CI/CD, and GitHub Actions.
* Prototype rapidly, gather feedback from business users, and iterate toward production-ready implementations.
* Work closely with consumer marketing teams to improve customer acquisition, engagement, retention, personalization, and operational efficiency.
* Analyze customer and business data to identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for AI and automation.
* Monitor production AI systems, evaluate LLM performance, troubleshoot failures, and improve reliability and cost efficiency.
* Communicate technical solutions, limitations, and tradeoffs clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Own projects end to end, from discovery and architecture through development, deployment, adoption, and ongoing optimization.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong professional experience with Python or a comparable backend language, along with working frontend capability.
* Proficient with Claude Code as a primary development workflow, with the judgment to know when AI output needs human review before it ships. Anthropic Claude certification (CCDV-F or CCAR-P) is a plus.
* Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI-powered applications, agents, or automation into production.
* Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs, with Claude as the primary platform. Working proficiency across multiple models is expected.
* Software architecture experience, including designing systems rather than only implementing against someone else's design.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, databases, SQL, and cloud environments.
* Experience with production software development, Git, Docker, and CI/CD.
* Direct experience partnering with consumer marketing teams, with a working understanding of acquisition, engagement, retention, and personalization, and the ability to translate marketing objectives into technical solutions.
* Excellent communication skills and genuine confidence working with non-technical departments.
* Proven ability to take an ambiguous business problem and turn it into a working technical solution with minimal direction.
* Comfort operating across disciplines, including product, delivery, and quality, rather than staying strictly within an engineering lane.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with Claude Code, MCP, LangGraph, LangChain, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and AI agent architectures.
* Experience with Snowflake, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis, dbt, and modern data pipelines.
* Experience with AWS or GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, serverless architecture, GitHub Actions, and Terraform.
* Experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
* Experience with n8n, Make, Zapier, Power Automate, or other workflow automation platforms.
* Experience integrating HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, Segment, Customer.io, Braze, or similar CRM and marketing platforms.
* Experience with Google Analytics, Meta Ads APIs, Google Ads APIs, or other marketing and customer data APIs.
* Experience with customer data platforms, marketing automation, personalization, or consumer analytics.
* Experience building AI solutions for consumer marketing, growth, sales, customer support, or operations.
* Experience with LLM evaluation, observability, prompt optimization, and AI system cost management.
* Experience in a forward-deployed, consulting, client-facing, startup, or highly autonomous engineering environment.

title: Optical Network Development Engineer , Capacity Restoration Team
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Network Development Engineers (NDEs) on CRT are Builders. You don't implement off-the-shelf solutions. You create new ones — solutions that go beyond traditional industry approaches.
  
  
As an Optical NDE, you will work at the component level of CRT's optical transport restoration stack. You will troubleshoot, diagnose, and restore out-of-service DWDM capacity across Amazon's backbone and metro optical networks. You will build and improve automation that accelerates optical capacity restoration — from fiber fault isolation to amplifier recovery to wavelength re-provisioning.
  
  
Your scope covers small to mid-size optical components, features, and processes. You will actively learn the team's optical architecture and apply it to build working solutions. You will create secure, stable, testable, and maintainable code with minimal defects.
  
  
This role bridges optical operations and engineering. You will both operate the optical network and write code to make operations faster. NDEs on CRT do not depend on vendors for design or support.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Optical Restoration & Troubleshooting
  
  

* Troubleshoot and restore out-of-service optical capacity across DWDM backbone and metro networks, including coherent optics, amplifiers (EDFA/Raman), ROADMs, and mux/demux components.
* Diagnose optical impairments: fiber attenuation, connector/splice loss, chromatic dispersion, PMD, OSNR degradation, and nonlinear effects (FWM, SPM, XPM, SBS).
* Execute and interpret OTDR traces, optical spectrum analyzer (OSA) readings, and power meter measurements to isolate physical-layer faults.
* Develop link test plans and structured diagnostic output for optical circuits that enable system-guided troubleshooting.
* Coordinate with fiber operations and vendor teams for fiber splicing, connector cleaning, and hardware RMA workflows.

Automation & Tooling
  
  

* Build and improve automation components that accelerate optical link and device restoration (e.g., automated span loss validation, amplifier reset sequences, wavelength re-provisioning scripts).
* Extend and integrate with existing tooling to improve monitoring and alerting for out-of-service optical capacity.
* Develop scripts to parse and correlate optical alarms from network management systems and identify systemic patterns.
* Write clean, testable code (Python preferred) with documentation that supports future engineers.

Metrics, Monitoring & Operations
  
  

* Create and maintain team-level operational metrics, monitors, and processes tied to CRT KPIs: MTTR, restoration success rate, backlog depth, and optical capacity out-of-service burndown.
* Contribute to optical network health dashboards tracking OSNR trends, amplifier performance, and span loss baselines.
* Participate in on-call rotations. Support follow-the-sun coverage across Seattle and Bangalore.
* Document optical systems, tools, and runbooks clearly. Keep documentation current as systems evolve.
* Contribute to design reviews and operational improvement discussions.
* Actively learn team product architecture — both optical transport and IP layers — and apply that knowledge to deliver working solutions.

A day in the life
  
  

* Troubleshoot out-of-service DWDM spans: diagnose optical power degradation, amplifier faults, fiber impairments, and coherent optic alarms across backbone and metro networks.
* Analyze OSNR, chromatic dispersion, and PMD data to identify root causes of optical circuit failures and determine restoration paths.
* Develop and improve automation scripts to accelerate optical capacity restoration workflows (e.g., wavelength re-provisioning, span validation, amplifier reset sequences).
* Coordinate with fiber operations teams on OTDR testing, fiber splicing, and physical layer fault isolation.
* Implement small-to-mid-scope optical tooling (e.g., automated span loss validation, optical health check scripts, amplifier monitoring dashboards).
* Integrate with existing tooling ecosystem (workflow orchestration engines, optical network management systems, link testing services).
* Participate in design reviews and operational improvement discussions for optical restoration processes.
* Document optical systems, troubleshooting runbooks, and restoration procedures clearly for future engineers.
* Participate in on-call rotations supporting follow-the-sun optical restoration coverage.

**About The Team**
The Capacity Restoration Team (CRT) sits within Backbone, Enterprise, Regional Engineering (BERE) organization. Our mission is to own end-to-end restoration of out-of-service inter-metro and intra-metro network capacity.
  
  
CRT reduces operational backlog, improves network health monitoring systems, and drives time-to-remediate (TTR) down. Today, a significant network capacity is out of service at any given time. The operational workload is capacity related and heavily manual and we are building the team and automation to change that.
  
  
We operate across Seattle, Dublin, Bangalore, Hyderabad and Sydney for follow-the-sun coverage. CRT acts as the connective layer between Engineering, Operations, Tooling, and Software teams.
  
  
**About Aws**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, or experience designing digital communication systems
* 1+ years of network cabling, optic types, and test equipment experience, or experience in computer networking
* Experience in one or more scripting languages (e.g., Python, Ruby, Perl)
* Experience in a Linux or Unix environment
* Understanding of DWDM technology fundamentals: wavelength multiplexing, optical amplification (EDFA, Raman), coherent detection, and modulation formats.
* Knowledge of fiber optic fundamentals: single-mode fiber types (G.652, G.654, G.655), attenuation, chromatic dispersion, and PMD.

* Lead cross-functional working groups with business owners, data engineers, and domain experts.

* Identify and prioritise high-impact AI/ML opportunities across Commercial domains (Marketing, Sales, Pricing).
* Build and share domain expertise, contributing to the development of team capability roadmaps.
* Influence tooling and platform strategy decisions based on emerging best practices and business requirements.
* Drive measurable business outcomes — framing model outputs in terms of ROI, efficiency gains, or revenue impact.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or related quantitative field (Master's preferred)

* Proven track record leading analytical projects with measurable business impact
* Advanced proficiency with Python ecosystem (scikit-learn, TensorFlow/PyTorch, pandas, numpy)
* Strong SQL skills and experience with cloud data platforms (AWS, Azure, Databricks)
* Experience with ML frameworks, version control (Git), and CI/CD for model deployment
* Demonstrated leadership through mentoring, technical presentations, or cross-functional project ownership

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters

͏

1. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software

* Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
* Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
* Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
* Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design

͏

* Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
* Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
* Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
* Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
* Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
* Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
* Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
* Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
* Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders

͏

* Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code

* Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc

description:
**Description**
Imagine being part of a team building the future of wearable technology. Amazon is focused on developing devices that seamlessly integrate technology and design into forms that are familiar to millions of people, in ways that have never been done before. From innovative smart glasses to a growing lineup of cutting-edge wearable devices, we are redefining how people engage with the world around them.
  
  
If you are excited about pushing the envelope and developing brand-new experiences that empower users to do more as they engage with the physical world, we would love to meet you.
  
  
We are looking for a passionate, talented Software Development Engineer with a growth mindset and a versatile skill set to help us bring this vision to life.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for a talented and passionate Software Engineer to be part of an exciting team building device software. You will have an enormous opportunity to make a large impact on the design, architecture, and implementation of cutting edge products used every day, by people you know. In this role, you will:
  
  

* Be responsible for system architecture and development of new features for embedded systems
* Investigate, prototype and deliver new and innovative system solutions
* Design, develop and verify firmware for embedded systems
* Participate in design reviews, API development, and documentation
* Work with new technologies that are vital to product development
* Deliver investigation plans and reports, architectural documents, design specs, software and firmware source code, build scripts

Build expertise in one or more core wireless technologies- WiFi, Bluetooth
  
  

* Perform tasks including debug, bring-up, Beta and production software development
* Successfully collaborate with both software and hardware product teams

**About The Team**
Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about how you bring energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.
  
  
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of embedded firmware development experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience in embedded software design, development and debugging preferably on ARM based platforms
* Experience in coding in C/C++
* Experience with RTOS and embedded Linux development
* Board level experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep understanding and Experience with Bluetooth Classic/BLE (HCI, L2CAP, GATT/GAP, profiles), protocol stacks, and wireless sniffers (e.g., Ellisys)
* Strong debugging/trouble-shooting skills of embedded systems
* Background in building factory test, interoperability, and certification test plans
* Experience with ARM based SOC architecture
* Can mentor other software developers to maintain architectural vision and software quality
